page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top centre above the text. Page number top left. Headings centred: "VE NE.", "CE NE", "GLI MI, vel ME GLI", each followed by a wavy ornament. No marginal notes visible on this page; faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.head: VE NE.
main_text.p: Vobis de illo, illa, illis: Eiv e ne parlo, Parlouene: Is de illo, illa, illis est vobis locutus.
Vos hinc, illinc, iftinc: Voiveneandáste, Andásteuene, Vos hinc, illinc, iftinc discessistis.
main_text.head: CE NE
main_text.p: Nob.de illo, illa, illis: E'ice ne parlo, Parloc cene: Is de illo, illa, illis est nob.locut°.
Nos hinc, illinc, iftinc: Nói ce nepartim-mo, Partimmocene, Nos hinc, illinc, iftinc discessimus.
Cōiunguntur deinceps hæ particulæ cū articulis, vt, qui mox inf à ponētur, typi declarāt, ex quib.itidē significatio earū &vsus perspicuē cognoici poterit.
main_text.head: GLI MI, vel ME GLI
main_text.p: Mihi illos: Gli mi, vel me gli raccomandò, & Raccomandóglimi, vel Raccomandoimme-gli, Mihi illos commendauit.
Me illi: Gli mi, vel me gli raccomandái: &, Raccomandáiglimi, vel Raccommandái-megli, Me illi commendaui.

page.notes: Some words in the Italian forms are doubtful (e.g. "Eiv e", "Voiveneandáste", "Nói ce") due to the scan quality. Faint show-through from the reverse page is present and was omitted.
